programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the "clash for the ages" as host city Mumbai Pickle Power takes on their fierce rivals, Delhi Dilwale, in a thrilling Day 2 encounter of the World Pickleball League Season 2. The day begins on a somber note with a tribute to the late Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Shri Ajit Pawar, as players compete with black armbands in front of a quieted stadium.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Tied at 2-2 entering the broadcast, this match features intense mixed doubles action that decides the series.Key matchups include Purdue’s Emma Jones and Jay Barath facing off against Creighton’s Russell Lee and Lucy. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Witness an unexpected and electrifying Mixed Pro Doubles showdown from the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida! Originally scheduled for a back court, this highly anticipated match featuring Andre Agassi and Anna Leigh Waters was moved to Championship Court due to overwhelming crowd demand, creating an unforgettable atmosphere. Relive every moment as these top players battle it out in a thrilling display of professional pickleball. Don't miss the action from East Naples Community Park – the epicenter of pickleball!

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the high-octane energy of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Bengaluru Jawans go head-to-head with the Rajasthan Titans at the iconic Jio World Garden in Mumbai. The stakes are higher than ever in this Day 9, Tie 16 clash, featuring elite matchups such as the "women's singles player of the season" Katrina Stewart facing off against the resilient Lorena Dupnik. Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2022
programme.desc: YouTuber Danny Duncan teams up with Pickleball pro Anna Leigh Waters in a match against Pickleball pro Leigh Waters & teammate, former NFL quarterback Connor Shaw.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the tactical intensity of the World Pickleball League as the Rajasthan Titans look to mount a comeback against the surging Hyderabad Superstars. This episode spotlights a generational clash in the men's singles match between Rajasthan’s Jack Foster and Hyderabad’s Marcelo Jardim, a 51-year-old former world No. 3 in padel and a true legend of racquet sports.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden as the high-stakes battle for the top four intensifies between the Hyderabad Superstars and Delhi Dilwale. With legendary co-owner Sunil Gavaskar watching from the sidelines, the Dilwale look to maintain their winning streak against a fiercely aggressive Hyderabad squad known for their wild celebrations and relentless energy. This tie features a series of high-octane clashes, from the strategic precision of Shawn Mendes and Alejandra Lopez in women’s singles to the "grueling" 15-minute sprints of elite doubles play. As the "Band of Honor" leaderboard hangs in the balance, every rally becomes a desperate fight for survival in one of the world's most prestigious pickleball arenas.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: On January 31, 2023 - the Scottsdale Scorchers face off against the Tempe Tornadoes - live at The Orchard!

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The National Pickleball League heats up as the Indianapolis Drivers take on the Austin Ignite in a coed team match packed with intensity, teamwork, and standout rallies. Representing two competitive NPL franchises, this mixed showdown brings high-level play, strategic depth, and crowd-fueled energy to the court. Whether you're cheering for the Drivers or backing the Ignite, this match is a showcase of what makes NPL team pickleball exciting to watch.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: The high-stakes action continues on Day 9 with the Second Semi-Final of the World Pickleball League (WPBL), featuring Pune United against Mumbai Pickle Power. The air is thick with anticipation, especially with the major news that Mumbai's star player, Brandon Lane, may not be available for the matchup.

programme.title: The PressBox Party
programme.desc: With Ray Colaiacovo sitting in for Tim Ring, Dave Benz talks about the growing craze of pickleball and how Pickleball first arrived to the masses on national TV via the US Open Pickleball Championship.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Stefan Andren and Alix Truong take on Christine Karges and Eric Oncins in this Mixed Pro Split Age Backdraw Semifinal match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Filmed at the US Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida, this Pro Women’s Doubles matchup features the powerhouse mother-daughter team Leigh and Anna Leigh Waters, known for their aggressive tactics and flawless communication. They square off against promising challengers Alexa Schull and Ava Cavataio, who bring fearless shot-making and tight teamwork to the court. From baseline drives to net duels, this clash of generations delivers fast-paced action, strategic rallies, and plenty of highlight-worthy moments.

programme.title: Breaking Pickleball
programme.desc: The Arizona Pickleball League is created -- 5 teams in the league, 4 teams make the playoffs, 1 will not. Meet Kyle Koszuta of the Tempe Tornadoes.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: In the finals of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, the Fort Myers Flamingos and the GMV Chomp go head-to-head. The commentators, including Angel, highlight the youth and fire of Fort Myers player Jade and the consistent dominance of the number one women's team, the GMV Chomp. The match is a best-of-three, rally-scoring format with games to 21. The episode showcases impressive plays from Stevie and Kelsey, and praises Heather Nobler's "nasty" two-handed backhand. The commentators also discuss the challenge for the team coming out of pool number two, which has less rest time before the finals.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Pros vs College Allstars at the 2025 NCPA Championships from Las Vegas.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: In this US Open semifinal showdown, top seeds Kyle Yates and Andrei Daescu face off against the dynamic duo of Austin Gridley and Mario Barrientos. With strategic finesse and explosive play, both teams battle for a spot in the final. A must-watch clash of styles and strengths on Championship Court.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.desc: Jason Kennedy and Wes Burrows challenge Taylor Lautner and David Dobrik.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes semifinal showdown at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championships as the Texas Longhorns take on the Grand Canyon University Antelopes. Despite predictive analytics giving them a 0% win probability, the GCU "Antelopes" display elite "Skills" early on, jumping to a dominant 11-1 lead against the professional-level talent of the Longhorns. The "Racing" tempo of the match is fueled by a relentless GCU crowd that puts immense pressure on Texas stars like Zoya Khan and Natalie Loo. With the defending champions already sidelined, both teams showcase "Freestyle" grit and creativity in a battle to crown a brand-new national champion.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. A key dynamic of this match is that Courter and Carter had the advantage of playing under the shaded court conditions just before, while Dawson and Williams were coming from outside. Jen Dawson is noted as being a seasoned player on this court, having a triple crown in the Senior Pro divisions.

programme.title: Breaking Pickleball
programme.desc: The final two teams battle it out for the Orchard Championship Cup.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: April 11, 2023 - the Tempe Tornadoes and Scottsdale Scorchers go at it in a sizzling hot match - live at The Orchard!

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: Experience the thrilling showdown at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships as twin brothers Hunter Johnson and Yates Johnson face off for the very first time in the men's pro singles gold medal match. Both top seeds with years of experience playing doubles together, these brothers bring a unique dynamic filled with expert strategy, rapid exchanges, and emotional rivalry. From early leads and tactical shot-making to late-game drama and camaraderie, watch Hunter and Yates battle it out point by point in a historic and captivating final. Featuring expert commentary and insights into their playing styles, this match is a must-watch for pickleball fans everywhere.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Kansas City Stingers face off against the Columbus Hotshots in a mixed NPL team match.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Former national champions collide in a high-stakes semifinal as the North Carolina Tar Heels take on the Utah Tech Trailblazers. With the historic opportunity to become the first program to reach three finals and potentially the first-ever two-time national champion, these "familiar foes" bring elite athleticism and championship pedigree to the court. Experience the intensity at Lifetime Peachtree Corners as raw power meets tactical precision in a pulse-pounding battle for a spot in the national championship match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Jorja Johnson faces off against Simone Jardim in this match-up of the Women's Pro Single Quarterfinal.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Christine Karges and David Weinbach take on Lee Whitwell and Jaime Oncins in this Mixed Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the final showdown of the league stages as Delhi Dilwale and the Rajasthan Titans clash in a high-stakes battle for pride and final positioning. The atmosphere is electric as Rajasthan’s Lorena Dupnik delivers a "professional performance" in a come-from-behind singles victory against Delhi’s Mehek Kuan, setting a fierce tone for the tie. Witness a tactical masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the relentless power of Max Mantor and the "next level" skills of Trang Huynh as they attempt to dismantle the Titans’ defensive wall. With veteran Rob Cassidy making his highly anticipated men's doubles debut, every rally becomes a desperate fight for dominance in the season's final league encounter.

programme.desc: October 11, 2022 - Live from The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health, it's Tuesday Night Pickleball

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from Virginia Beach, this Week 3, Day 2 matchup of the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 features Liberty University facing Carnegie Mellon University. Liberty enters the match strong, having already secured wins in women's doubles. The broadcast highlights the Men's Doubles game where Liberty's Derek Kraje and Ben Rice dominate with a 11-6 victory, utilizing aggressive net play and strategic resets.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2022
programme.desc: The US Open took place April 24-30, 2022 in Naples, FL. The Women's Doubles Final was a match up of Catherine Parenteau & Lea Jansen vs. Irina Tereschenko & Andrea Koop.

programme.desc: Jason Kennedy and Wes Burrows challenge Colton Underwood and Kit Hoover.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)

programme.desc: December 5, 2023 - Welcome to the first round of the semi-finals for season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Peoria Pythons face-off against the Tempe Tornadoes.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The championship title is on the line as the Clemson Tigers face off against the powerhouse UVA Cavaliers in the DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Virginia Super Regional Finals. programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!

programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: FishON! | Spring on the Ivanhoe: Post-Spawn Walleye Adventures
programme.desc: In Episode 3, we navigate the serene waters of the Ivanhoe River, embracing the beauty of spring as we target post-spawn walleye. With rods in hand, we explore the river's productive fishing spots, uncovering the best techniques and tips for a successful catch in this transitional season. From scenic backdrops to thrilling strikes, this episode captures the essence of spring fishing at its finest.

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: ATA 223: Who's Under the Most Pressure? Breaking Down the Final Signature Before Worlds - With just one Signature event remaining before the ACL World Championships, this week on Around The ACL, Meesh, Jake, and Anthony take a step back to look at the biggest storylines heading into the home stretch of the season. Which players have the most to prove? Who's carrying the most pressure? And what does each contender still need to show before the biggest event of the year? - The crew discusses the players facing the highest expectations entering the final Signature, identifies the one thing they still need to see from several of the sport's biggest names before Worlds, and debates which contenders remain the biggest question marks despite strong seasons. To wrap up the show, it's another edition of "Change My Mind," featuring bold statements on Gabriel Clauson, Matt Guy, Logan Chamberlain, Ryan Wiedenfeld, the depth of today's professional field, and whether there are truly ten players capable of winning the World Championship. - Join us for an opinion-filled episode as we count down to the final Signature event of the season and begin the march toward Worlds.
